answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by enforcing a strict proof-of-burn entry fee, where every autonomous participant must permanently destroy scarce native tokens inside a cryptographic vault before gaining network privileges. Just as genuine saffron is prohibitively expensive to mass-produce, this irreversible capital destruction imposes a severe, unrecoverable financial cost on any adversary attempting to spawn thousands of fake identities that wander across the network to manipulate consensus or drain shared resources.
